expected.name: Shinzaburo Sumida
expected.description: Shinzaburo Sumida was a Honolulu Nisei businessman and vice president of T. Sumida & Co.; Daizo Sumida was his uncle and adoptive father. JCCH records December 1941 arrest, Sand Island detention and February 1942 mainland transfer. Listed confinement includes Angel Island March 1942, Camp McCoy March-May 1942, Camp Forrest May-June 1942 and Camp Livingston June-August 1942. His August 1942 return to Hawaii continued in Sand Island August 1942-March 1943 and Honouliuli March 1943-November 1944. He was transferred again to the mainland November 1944, held at Tule Lake November 1944-November 1945 and returned to Honolulu aboard Shawnee December 1945. This was US wartime civilian incarceration; no individual criminal conviction is established by the archive. Source: https://incarceration.jcchawaii.org/internees/sumida-shinzaburo

operations.research_note: Honolulu Star-Bulletin June19,2006 obituary records Shinzaburo Sumida death June1,2006. Identity corroborated by Honolulu brewery presidency and son Ronald in JCCH oral-history family record, and Punahou alumni account naming wife Mariko and children Ronald,Aileen,Andrew. Filled exact death date only; existing1914birthyear and custody chronology preserved. Do not treat November1945TuleLake departure or December1945Hawaii arrival as exact finalrelease.
